title: Design System: The Records Office (CODE Admin)

extensions.scope: Admin-only, scoped to the `.ro` root class (webapp/src/app/globals.css). Does not govern the public site (navy/gold + Inter), which is out of scope.

figure.purpose: Large stamped money-plate amounts. JetBrains Mono tabular, the loudest dashboard element.

plate.purpose: Engraved label-plate headers and the CODE·RECORDS mark. Archivo uppercase, tracked.

body.purpose: Table cells, input text, panel prose. Archivo.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, stamp/caption micro-text. Archivo 700 uppercase, tracked.

mono.purpose: Receipt numbers, nav indices, file-spine text. JetBrains Mono tabular at label scale.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default barely-there seating for panels and job-cards.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Popovers, modals, and hover-raised punch squares only.

shadows.name: engraved-plate
shadows.purpose: Engraved edge on steel label plates.

shadows.name: spine-marker
shadows.purpose: Hard oxide-red left bar on the active nav tab — the file-pulled-from-rail marker (world-native, not decorative).

shadows.name: ledger-rule
shadows.purpose: The blue underline of the two-colour ledger rule, paired with a 1.5px oxide-red border-bottom.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Tab/section reveal and hover state easing (~0.14s).

motion.name: stamp-settle
motion.purpose: One-shot payment-stamp animation: scales and rotates into place. The world's authored moment.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables stamp-settle, reveal, spine pull-out translate, and punch hover lift.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Steel rail shows at md+; below md it collapses to a steel top bar with horizontal nav.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Page padding steps up (px-4 py-6 -> sm:px-8 sm:py-9).

narrative.overview: The institute's steel records room made digital — the physical thing this software replaces, not a SaaS dashboard. The surface reads as a daytime clerk's worktop under tubelight: an enamel-on-steel grey-green chrome rail down the side, file-cream panels and job-cards on the desk, engraved metal label plates for headers, inked rubber-stamps for status, and a punch-card grid for the months of an installment plan. It deliberately refuses the incumbent 'AI slop' template (sidebar + sparkline stat-card + rounded-2xl). The world is dense but calm, built for one operator who lives in it for hours with a student waiting; money truth is the loudest thing on screen, stamped into metal number-plates in a tabular mono face. Everything is squared and hairline-bordered like filed records; depth is engraved (inset light and shadow) rather than floated. Colour is a strict working code — four accents, each meaning one operational thing. The mode is Operate and the theme is deliberately light; there is no dark theme for admin, and contrast targets WCAG 2.1 AA.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel-on-steel grey-green chrome rail + file-cream content ground.
A four-colour working code (oxide-red, ink-blue, stamp-green, ochre) and nothing else.
Engraved label plates, inked status stamps, numbered file-spine nav, punch-card month grid.
Squared corners (3-4px), hairlines, inset 'engraved' shadows — no soft SaaS drop shadows.
JetBrains Mono tabular figures for every rupee amount and receipt number; Archivo for everything else.
Status is never colour-only: colour + boxed shape marker + text label, always.

rules.name: The Colour-Code Rule
rules.body: Exactly four working accents exist and each means one thing: oxide-red = overdue/danger, ink-blue = action, stamp-green = paid, ochre = due. Never repurpose an accent for decoration or a second meaning; a new surface does not get a free brand colour.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Status is conveyed by colour plus a boxed shape marker plus a text label — never colour alone. A stamp's solid square = settled, hollow square = outstanding; the word is always present.

rules.name: The Mono-Money Rule
rules.body: Every rupee figure and every receipt number is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, no exceptions. Money that isn't monospaced isn't trusted.

rules.name: The Plate-Not-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The engraved label plate carries its own title and stands alone as a section header. It is never used as a kicker or eyebrow stacked above a larger heading.

rules.name: The Engraved-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and gain depth from inset light/shadow and hairlines. A soft outward drop shadow appears only as a response to elevation (modal, popover) — never as ambient decoration on a resting card.

rules.name: The Squared-Records Rule
rules.body: Corner radii stay within 2-4px. If a shape needs to look filed and official, it is squared and hairline-bordered; soft or pill geometry belongs to the out-of-scope public site.

dos: Do set every rupee figure and receipt number in JetBrains Mono tabular (The Mono-Money Rule).
Do encode status with colour + boxed shape marker + text label together (The Never-Colour-Alone Rule).
Do keep radii in the 2-4px squared band and define surfaces with hairline borders (The Squared-Records Rule).
Do convey depth with inset light/shadow and hairlines; reserve outward drop shadows for modals/popovers (The Engraved-Not-Floating Rule).
Do use the engraved label plate as a standalone section header carrying its own title.
Do hold to the four-colour working code and give each accent exactly one meaning (The Colour-Code Rule).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the stamp-settle, section reveal, spine pull-out, and punch hover all fall back to no motion.
donts: Don't ship soft SaaS drop shadows, rounded-2xl cards, or a sparkline stat-card layout — the named anti-reference ('AI slop').
Don't use a working accent for decoration or a second meaning; there is no free brand colour on a new surface.
Don't stack a label plate as a kicker/eyebrow above a heading (The Plate-Not-Eyebrow Rule).
Don't introduce a dark theme for admin; this is a deliberately light daytime-desk world.
Don't let this system leak onto the public site, or the public navy/gold + Inter system leak into the .ro admin subtree.
Don't substitute glyph icons, an icon font, or emoji for the authored 1.6-stroke line set.
